描述_EN: episode 2: attack of the clones is a 2002 space opera film directed by george lucas. star wars: a new hope was released in 1977. sequels released in 1980 and 1983 were equally successful. it was released on may 16th of that year and was set ten years after the previous film, the phantom menace. the first film of george lucas' trilogies was the most successful in american history and grossed over $290 million. a whole host of toy figures, spacecrafts and toy guns were available, as well as costumes, stationery, bedroom accessories and slippers. in attack of the clones, padmé amidala becomes a senator from the planet naboo, showing that she has grown since her time as queen. the films captured their imagination and paved the way for the merchandising that accompanies many films today.
描述_ZN: 《第二集：克隆人的进攻》是一部2002年的太空歌剧电影，由乔治-卢卡斯导演。 《星球大战：新希望》于1977年上映。 1980年和1983年发行的续集同样成功。 该片于当年5月16日上映，背景是前一部电影《幽灵的威胁》的十年后。 乔治-卢卡斯的三部曲中的第一部电影是美国历史上最成功的，总票房超过2.9亿美元。 一大堆的玩具人物、太空飞船和玩具枪，以及服装、文具、卧室配件和拖鞋。 在《克隆人的进攻》中，帕德梅-阿米达拉成为纳布星球的参议员，表明她在成为女王之后已经成长。 这些电影抓住了他们的想象力，为今天许多电影的商品销售铺平了道路。
